checkpointClasses.readiness: validate dependencies, architecture version, scope, authority preservation and assurance
checkpointClasses.work_order: validate Work Order completeness, change surfaces, proofs, dogfooding and migrations
checkpointClasses.pr_conformance: evaluate exact implementation revision against architecture and forbidden shortcuts
checkpointClasses.verification_entry: require exact revision-bound verification and required evidence
checkpointClasses.fitness: measure quality attributes and architecture fitness where declared
checkpointClasses.release: require release strategy, operational evidence, rollback or containment for applicable risk

commonRules: revision-bound where implementation content is evaluated
tenant/data boundary mismatches reject before content access
evidence is persisted through its owning authority
checkpoint orchestration never becomes a domain mutation authority
